10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

1231|117e1541.name: Grif Wildheart
1231|117e1541.text: Before beginning a hunt, it is wise to ask someone what you are looking for before you begin looking for it.

1253|a23f7e7e.name: Father Gavin
1253|a23f7e7e.text: Welcome, $c, to the Misty Pine. If you are weary from your travels, feel free to rest and warm yourself inside. And perhaps if you've some spare time, you could assist me in some tasks.

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

5115|a665cdb8.name: Daera Brightspear
5115|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5116|8329ccbb.name: Olmin Burningbeard
5116|8329ccbb.text: If you're here to be trained in the tactics and strategy of hunting, you've come to the right place!

5193|e9a7b43b.name: Rebecca Laughlin
5193|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

5595|ab5dd850.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

432-accept.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-accept.text:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
432-accept.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

432-complete.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-complete.text:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
432-complete.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-accept.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-accept.text:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
433-accept.title: The Public Servant

433-complete.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-complete.text:
It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

Thank you for your assistance, $N.
433-complete.title: The Public Servant

95212-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
95212-progress.text: You look chilly, $c. How goes the hunt?
95212-progress.title: Never Saddle on Quality

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth
